title: Audit Export: destination health visualization + troubleshooting panel
creator: Tessa Morgan
description:
Design the health visualization + troubleshooting panel for the Console “Security → Audit Export” experience. This is the destination detail view component that answers: Is my export working? If not, what should I do next?

Context
- Feature: SIEM-ready audit export (beta) with sinks: Splunk HEC, Datadog Logs intake, S3.
- Delivery semantics: at-least-once; duplicates possible; provide dedupe guidance.
- Key backend signals (from ENG-13928): last_success_at, last_error, backlog_estimate, per-destination status state (enabled/paused/degraded).

Goals
- Make status legible at a glance (healthy vs lagging vs failing vs paused).
- Provide actionable troubleshooting steps without requiring SRE/support.
- Avoid leaking sensitive info (e.g., show error IDs + redacted messages; do not echo secrets/headers).
- Link to relevant docs/runbooks (customer-facing) and include “copy debug bundle” for support.

Non-goals
- Full incident management UX (paging, timelines). Keep this lightweight for beta.
- Advanced query builder for SIEM dashboards.

Design scope
1) Health header (destination detail)
- Status pill: Healthy | Delivering with lag | Failing | Paused | Disabled (final labels TBD)
- Primary metrics (display rules below):
  - Last delivered: timestamp (relative + exact)
  - Delivery lag / backlog estimate: “~N events pending” OR “~Xm behind” (we likely only have backlog_estimate in beta)
  - Recent error: short summary + error_id (copyable)
- CTA row (contextual):
  - “Send test event” (if enabled)
  - “Pause export” / “Resume export”
  - “Retry now” (only if backend supports; otherwise remove)
  - “View setup guide” (sink-specific)

2) Troubleshooting panel (accordion or side panel)
- Sections:
  A. Common issues (sink-specific templates)
     - Auth/permissions (401/403)
     - Throttling / rate limiting (429)
     - Sink 5xx / network errors
     - Schema rejection / payload too large
     - Duplicates observed (expected; link dedupe guidance)
  B. Recommended checks
     - “Verify credentials” / “Rotate token” guidance (no secret reveal)
     - “Confirm endpoint/region” (esp. Datadog)
     - “Confirm index/source type” (Splunk)
     - “S3 bucket policy / KMS permissions” (S3)
  C. When to contact support
     - “Provide error ID and destination ID”
     - “Export time window + estimated lag”
     - “Workspace/tenant ID”
- Each item should include a short description and a single action link (docs) or button (copy error ID).

3) Event delivery indicators (lightweight)
- Optional mini-chart: last 60 minutes delivery sparkline OR last 24h “delivered vs failed” counts.
- If metrics aren’t available in beta, design should gracefully omit and show “Telemetry coming soon” (avoid empty states that look broken).

4) Empty/edge states
- New destination (never delivered): show “Not yet delivered” + prompt to send test event.
- Paused by user: show paused explanation + resume CTA.
- Paused by system / degraded: show reason (generic) + link “Learn more” + “Copy error ID”.
- Multiple error types: show the most recent + “View all errors” link (if backend can provide). Otherwise keep to “Last error”.

Display & copy rules (important)
- Avoid absolute claims like “No data loss” (at-least-once). Use “Redwood retries delivery; duplicates may occur.”
- Show relative time prominently (“2m ago”), with exact timestamp on hover or secondary text.
- Backlog copy should avoid false precision: “~3.2k events pending” or “~3k” (rounding).
- Error text should be short and user-facing; show an opaque error_id for deeper detail.

Acceptance criteria
- Figma frames cover:
  - Healthy destination
  - Lagging destination (backlog)
  - Failing destination (auth error)
  - Paused destination
  - Never-delivered destination
  - S3 duplicates guidance state (informational)
- Includes component spec notes for engineering:
  - Mapping from status fields → UI states
  - When each CTA is visible/disabled
  - Copy strings (draft) + redaction rules
  - Link targets per sink (Splunk/Datadog/S3)
- Review sign-off from Console eng lead (Chloe Martin) and Security Eng (Marcus Lin) on wording around delivery semantics + duplicates.

Open questions
- Do we have an explicit status enum from backend (enabled/paused/degraded), or do we infer from last_success_at/last_error/backlog?
- Can we support “Send test event” from destination detail for beta (ENG-13929)? If not, remove CTA and link to docs only.
- Should “Pause export” require a confirmation modal that warns about missed alerts in SIEM?

Links

- Design spec (eng): sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/audit-export-filtering-and-delivery-guarantees.json
- Feature overview: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/siem-ready-audit-export-overview.json
- Customer docs drafts (setup guides):
  - Splunk: sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/integration-guides/splunk-hec-setup-guide.json
  - Datadog: sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/integration-guides/datadog-logs-intake-setup-guide.json

Work notes / updates
- 2025-02-10: First pass component list + state mapping drafted; awaiting confirmation of which health fields are guaranteed in v1 API.
- 2025-02-13: Sync w/ Felix (Console backend): last_success_at + last_error + backlog_estimate are planned; no “error history” endpoint for beta.
- 2025-02-18: Copy review with Marcus Lin: ensure duplicates messaging is explicit; avoid implying exactly-once; add link to dedupe guidance in every sink troubleshooting section.

Reviewer checklist
- Does the UI clearly differentiate “lagging but delivering” vs “failing”?
- Are we providing actionable steps per sink without exposing secrets?
- Are the CTAs consistent with backend capabilities for beta?
- Does this remain usable for Hosted + Dedicated + Private (where “contact support” may differ)?
comments: 2025-02-11 (Chloe Martin): Please keep the header compact; destination list already shows a summary state. Detail page should add guidance, not duplicate everything. Also +1 to making error_id copyable.

2025-02-13 (Felix Schneider): For beta we can expose last_success_at, last_error_code (normalized), last_error_message (redacted), backlog_estimate. No per-minute delivery counts yet unless we pipe metrics into the API later.

2025-02-18 (Marcus Lin): Copy must state at-least-once and potential duplicates. Do not show raw HTTP responses (may include headers). Error messages should be curated / redacted server-side and treated as untrusted input.

2025-02-19 (Tessa Morgan): Updated frames to remove “View all errors” CTA; replaced with “Copy error ID” + sink-specific troubleshooting accordions. Pending final confirmation on paused-by-system wording (degraded vs paused).
